Privacy Policy

 Bindle (hereinafter referred to as "Application", "We", "Us", "Our") collects, uses, and protects users' personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how our users' personal data is collected, used, shared, and protected.

 1. Information Collected

 Bindle collects users' personal information only for the following purposes:

 - Mandatory Information:
 - Advertising ID: For users who interact with ads within the application, the Advertising ID provided by their device may be used for targeted advertising and performance analysis.
 - Username: Users choose a unique username within the app.
 - Email Address: Users' email addresses associated with their accounts within the app.

 - Optional Information:
 - Profile Photo: Users can choose to upload a profile photo.
 - Real Name, Phone Number and Gender: This information is not currently collected for any purpose. However, if it is decided to use this information to improve the user experience in the future, necessary updates will be made to our Privacy Policy.
 - Location Information: Users can grant location permission to see events near them. Location information can only be viewed by the user themselves.

 2. Use of Information

 The information collected may be used for the following purposes:
 - Displaying targeted ads: Advertising ID is used to provide personalized and non-personalized ads through third party advertising networks such as AdMob.
 - Creating and managing user accounts
 - Creating and participating in events
 - Showing events near users' locations
 - Enabling social interactions within the app (communities, event chats, etc.)
 - Processing in-app purchases (for consumables only)

 3. Sharing of Information

 Bindle does not share user information with third parties, but it may be shared in the following cases:
 - Third Party Service Providers: Third party service providers are used for AdMob ads and Play Store purchases. These services may use user information only to perform necessary transactions.
 - Legal Requirements: Information may be shared in response to legal or government requests.

 4. Data Security

 Bindle employs industry best practices to ensure the security of user data. However, we cannot guarantee that data transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

 5. User Rights

 Users have the following rights:
 - Access their personal data
 - Request updates to their personal data
 - Request deletion of their account
 - Ask any questions regarding the privacy policy

 6. Third Party Links

 The App may contain links to third party services such as AdMob and features such as the Play Store's purchasing system. The privacy policies of these third parties are independent of Bindle's policies, and we are not responsible for them.
 The app uses third party services, including AdMob, to serve advertisements. These services may use the device's Advertising ID to provide targeted advertising. Users can manage their Advertising ID preferences from their device settings.

 7. Policy Changes

 This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. When changes are made, the updated policy will be posted in the App. Users should check this page regularly to be aware of any changes to our privacy policy.

 8. Contact

 If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at the following address:

 E-mail: bindledestek@gmail.com

Introduction

 These Terms of Service ("Terms") apply to your use of the Bindle application ("Application"). By using the Application, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree to these Terms, please do not use the Application.

 Age Limit and User Obligations

 1. The Application is available to users who are 13 years of age or older. Users under the age of 13 are prohibited from using the App.
 2. When using the App, you are expected to not use it for illegal purposes, not to violate the rights of others, and to comply with all legal regulations.
 3. The App encourages users to refrain from harassing or harming other users.

 Prevention of Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE)

 1.The Application is committed to protecting children from sexual abuse, exploitation, and inappropriate content.
 2.Content Reporting and Moderation: Users can report inappropriate content, including potential CSAE-related content, using the in-app "Report Post", "Report User" and "Feedback and Support" feature. These reports are reviewed promptly by our moderation team.
 3.Prohibited Content: Any content involving child exploitation or abuse is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate removal and permanent account suspension.
 4.Collaboration with Authorities: Bindle collaborates with organizations such as the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) and relevant law enforcement agencies.
 5.For more information about CSAE standards, please refer to the following resources:
 *National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC): https://www.missingkids.org/
 *Internet Watch Foundation (IWF): https://www.iwf.org.uk/
 *UNICEF Child Protection Principles: https://www.unicef.org/protection

 Restrictions of Service and Disclaimers

 1. No guarantee is given that the App will operate uninterruptedly or error-free.
 2. We accept no liability for any data loss or damage that may occur as a result of the use of the App.
 3. Your account may be suspended or terminated if you violate these Terms.

 Data Use and Privacy

 1. The App only collects username, email address, profile photo (optional), and location data.
 2. Location data is only visible to the user and will be used for event recommendations.
 3. User name and profile photo may be shared with other users within events and communities.
 4. User data is only available to the user within the App will be used to improve your experience.

 Third Party Links and Ads

 1. The App uses a third-party advertising provider, AdMob. This means that user data may be collected through ads and other content.
 2. AdMob and other third-party services may collect and use user data. You are encouraged to review the privacy policies of these services.

 Account Deletion and App Termination

 1. Users can delete their accounts and data's from within the App.
 2. Users will be notified if the App is updated or terminated at any time. There is no guarantee that the App services will be uninterrupted.

 Purchase-Related Warnings and Obligations

 If you purchase in-app tickets and your payment is approved, it is strongly advised that you remain logged into the same account until your reward is delivered. Avoid logging out or switching accounts during this process.
 If your payment status is "approved" but the reward takes time to reflect in the Application, and you switch to another account in the meantime, the new account may incorrectly receive the reward due to system checks. To prevent such issues, do not switch accounts until the process is complete.
 In case you do not receive your reward after purchase, you can contact us via the "Feedback and Support" option in the Application menu or email us at bindledestek@gmail.com for assistance.
 Failure to follow these guidelines and switching accounts prematurely will not be our responsibility, and we accept no liability for such occurrences.

 Account Verification and Ownership

 If you do not verify your account through email or Google, the actual owner of the email address may later reclaim the account by using "Sign in with Google" or the "Forgot Password" option. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to verify that the account belongs to you before making any purchases.
 We cannot transfer accounts or purchases to another user if ownership disputes arise due to a lack of account verification. Users are solely responsible for ensuring their account is secured and verified before making purchases.
